thread:
anya (product): Quick async — I sketched a minimal sprint scope for enterprise retention + BYOK handoff. Need fast alignment on launch criteria and customer promises. TL;DR: retention tiers, legal-hold escape hatch, BYOK key handshake, SOC2 evidence export format.

josh (eng): Please paste the sketch. Is this a full launch or pilot for a few customers?

anya (product): Pilot first (2 customers). Success criteria: 1) export contains complete audit trail for 90-day window; 2) BYOK handshake works with our KMS flow end-to-end; 3) no >200ms median E2E extra latency for host-mode requests.

ben (sales): For pilots we need explicit SLA language for retention retrieval times — customers ask for "evidence within 24hrs". Can we commit to that for the pilot?

sara (security): 24hrs for manual export is fine for pilot. For SOC2 we need immutable audit entries + signed digests. Also need a legal-hold toggle that prevents deletion even past TTL.

josh (eng): Notes:
- Audit payload: timestamp, service, request_id, model_id, user_id (pseudonymized), action, delta_tokens, result_pointer.
- We'll add an export job that streams JSONL gzip to S3-compatible bucket.
- BYOK handshake: simple RSA-signed cert exchange and an ephemeral KMS token in vault flow.

anya (product): That export shape aligns with what ops/legal asked for. Two product asks:
1) retention-tier labels: short(30d), mid(90d), long(365d) + manual-archive option.
2) customer-visible audit-search SLA: list vs full export (list <5s, full export <24h).

ops-bot: Deployment note: rolling canary will run on dedicated node pool. Add-on feature flag: enterprise-retention-v1.

josh (eng): Implementation constraints:
- KV indexing for "list" queries costs extra (we can provide list by indexed metadata; full export scans archived blobs).
- BYOK: we must support both AWS KMS and customer-managed HSM via PKCS#11 for pilot? That increases scope. Recommend MVP KMS-only with Opaque-key binary handshake.

anya (product): Agree on MVP KMS-only. We can add HSM in later sprint if pilot feedback requires it.

ben (sales): If HSM isn't in MVP, flag it in sales docs so customers don't expect HSM. Also want an approval flow for legal-hold requests (who can flip it).

sara (security): Approval flow: tenant-admin + support escalation for immediate holds. Audit entry must include approver id and justification. Retention toggles must be versioned.

josh (eng): Rough rollout plan: Week 1: export pipeline + retention TTL enforcement (no UI). Week 2: BYOK handshake + key validation. Week 3: export endpoint + legal-hold toggle + SLA instrumentation. Canary and telemetry from day 1.

anya (product): Launch criteria checklist (we can treat as gate):
- Exports: sample exports validated against schema (3 customers).
- BYOK: successful handshake + decrypt verification for at least 1 provider.
- Legal hold: toggle works and prevents garbage collection for test tenants.
- SOC2: signed digest per-day for proof-of-integrity.
- Docs: clear sales/ops runbook + retention matrix published.

ben (sales): Sounds good. Add "customer communication template" to docs so pilots know retrieval expectations.

sara (security): One more: threat model update and minimal cryptographic review before beta.

anya (product): Good call. I'll add that as mandatory pre-beta.

josh (eng): Nothing blocking from eng besides HSM scope. We should size this as 3-4 eng sprint-weeks across infra + runtime + ops work.

anya (product): OK. Action items:
- josh: write draft API + export schema PR by EOD Fri.
- sara: add threat model checklist and required cryptography notes by Mon.
- ben: draft customer pilot comms and SLA language by Tue.
- anya: collate and publish the runbook + launch checklist and schedule kickoff with pilot customers.

ben (sales): I'll ping two pilot customers today for opt-in.

anya (product): If no objections, I'll lock scope MVP = KMS-only BYOK, retention tiers (30/90/365), export JSONL.gz, legal-hold toggle, SOC2 digests. React with :white_check_mark: if good or comment blockers.

josh (eng): :white_check_mark:

sara (security): :white_check_mark:

ben (sales): :white_check_mark:

anya (product): Thanks — I'll publish the sprint doc and add to roadmap board. If anything else pops up, reply here.
